Name: Jira Information Disclosure
Description: Affected Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center versions allow unauthenticated users to enumerate users via an information disclosure vulnerability in QueryComponentRendererValue!Default.jspa endpoint. Affected versions are those before 8.5.13, versions 8.6.0 through 8.13.5, and versions 8.14.0 through 8.15.1
author: chumeng
